<article title="Warranty claims">
Fernwood gear is covered against defects in materials and workmanship for two years from delivery. Zippers, seams, buckles, and waterproof coatings are covered; normal wear, abrasion, and damage from misuse are not.

To start a claim, send us your order number, a description of the problem, and two photos showing the defect. We reply within two business days with a repair, replacement, or store credit decision.

Repairs are free and take two to three weeks including shipping. If we replace an item that is no longer made, we offer the closest current model or store credit for the original price.

</article>

Customer first name: Cyrus
<request>
discontinued model
my defective sleeping bag model is discontinued. what do i get if you cannot repair it?
</request>

Reply:
text:
Hi Cyrus,

Thanks for reaching out. If your sleeping bag is covered and can't be repaired, our policy is to replace discontinued items with the closest current model, or offer store credit for the original price. Which option applies depends on the review of your claim.

To start a claim, please send us your order number, a description of the defect, and two photos showing it. We reply within two business days with a repair, replacement, or store credit decision. Repairs are free and usually take two to three weeks including shipping.

A specialist will follow up with you as needed.

Fernwood Outfitters Support
